interaction_log.summary: Visual refactor for Governance Commit Dashboard under Micro-Etapa 2A Baseline
learnings: Fallback robust fonts are critical to avoid CDN dependencies on proprietary assets
Left action rails must expand using absolute/fixed overlay positioning without pushing main page flow
Sizing layout safe margins and height limits inside dynamic conversational shell inputs prevent content occlusion

interaction_log.summary: Integrated composition refinement on Governance commit dashboard under OS-MADLAB-CRM-COMPOSITION-REFINEMENT-20260529-002
learnings: Spacing and font sizing are primary design elements in Zero Chrome layouts.
Removing vertical/horizontal dividers makes layouts feel 30-50% less dense.
Light glass outer cards with high contrast inner JSON containers are excellent for technical readability.
